$comment: Kept by hand: this file is the definition. docs/design/schemas.md says how vendor schemas change.
title: OpenCode's database
description: The rows XenoNet reads from OpenCode's opencode.db ($XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode, ~/.local/share/opencode by default, or OPENCODE_DB), opened read only: its sessions and which files their edit tools changed. OpenCode 2 writes session_v2 and session_part, 1.x session and part; a database upgraded from 1.x can hold both. The version is the newest session's own (session.version).

parent_id.description: Set for a subagent's run: the session that started it

version.description: The OpenCode version that made it

cost.description: What OpenCode totalled for the session, in USD; the 1.19 layout

model_provider.description: model.providerID, taken out of the session's model JSON

model_id.description: model.id, taken out of the session's model JSON

session.description: select id, parent_id, directory, title, version, time_created, time_updated, time_archived, cost, tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_reasoning, tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write, and the providerID and id of model from session_v2 (OpenCode 2) and session (1.x), each that is there

edits.description: The file each edit, write and multiedit tool part names (data.state.input.filePath, or input.path in 2.x), and each apply_patch part's file headers, taken from session_part.data (2.x) and part.data (1.x); nothing else in a part is kept
